source:
@@U03825@@
Nimblest of the nimble, 赫耳墨斯 then
proves himself the master of artful devices,
the patron god of thieves and rascals
and all self-seekers.
In a flash he’s stolen the sea god’s trident,
the sword from 阿瑞斯’s scabbard,
阿波罗’s bow and arrows,
Hephaestus’s tongs, and would have stolen
Father 宙斯’s lightning
were he not in fear of the fire.
He wrestled and tripped up baby 厄洛斯,
and while she fondled him
filched the belt from 维纳斯’ waist.
(Music of ravishing pure melody played on strings is heard from
the cavern. All listen, and soon are deeply moved. The music continues
with full orchestra until indicated.)

@@U03827@@
Listen!
Hear these ravishing sounds!
Free yourselves of the ancient fables,
cast off your gods,
they have no meaning now.
Now we make greater demands.
What moves the heart must
come from the heart.

@@U03828@@
(She withdraws toward the rocks.)

@@U03830@@
If even you, dread being,
are moved by these pleasing sounds,
we who are newly restored to life
are moved to tears.
Let the sun lose its splendor
as long as there is light in the soul,
as long as in the heart's core
we find what all the world denies us.
translation:
@@U03825@@
敏捷中最敏捷的是赫耳墨斯
证明自己是巧妙装置的大师，
小偷和流氓的守护神
以及所有自私自利的人。
转眼间他就偷走了海神三叉戟，
阿瑞斯剑鞘中的剑，
阿波罗的弓箭，
赫菲斯托斯的钳子，并且会偷走
宙斯神父的闪电
难道他就不怕火吗？
他摔跤并绊倒了小厄洛斯，
当她抚摸他时
抢走了维纳斯腰间的腰带。
（从琴弦上传来令人陶醉的纯正旋律的音乐
洞穴。众人听了，很快都深受感动。音乐继续
与完整的管弦乐队合作，直到指定为止。）

@@U03827@@
听着！
听到这些令人陶醉的声音！
把自己从古老的寓言中解放出来，
抛弃你的神，
它们现在已经没有任何意义了。
现在我们提出了更高的要求。
凡事必能打动人心
来自内心。

@@U03828@@
（她退到岩石边。）

@@U03830@@
如果连你都害怕，
被这些悦耳的声音所感动，
我们刚恢复生机的人
感动得热泪盈眶。
让太阳失去它的光辉
只要心灵还有光，
只要在心的核心
我们发现了全世界都否认的东西。
